_note: Open / passthrough namespaces and templates. These keys are minted at RUNTIME (their names come from the document, an external tool, or a per-item qualifier), so they are NOT registered Property constants and do NOT appear in metadata-keys.json. This file is CURATED (hand-maintained, reviewed), not generated, and may not be exhaustive; the closed-namespace lint is the intended completeness backstop. provenance: 'file' = key name taken from document content; 'tool' = key name from an external tool/model.

open-namespaces.note: RFC822 / Outlook raw email header names
WARC record + HTTP response header names (also warc:http:)
MS Access document properties (also MDB_SUMMARY_PROP:, MDB_USER_PROP:)
ImageIO/drewnoakes unrecognized image tag names (also ICC:)

templates.note: XMP rdf:Alt language variants, e.g. dc:title:x-default, dc:title:fr. The unqualified base key holds the x-default value; to type a variant, resolve to its base key. NOTE: the language qualifier reuses ':' so 'dc:title:fr' is only disambiguated from a sub-namespace by this rule.
